question: Which of the following indigenously developed underwater naval mines was successfully tested by DRDO and the Indian Navy in May 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Multi-Influence Ground Mine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Multi-Influence Ground Mine** is an **indigenously developed underwater naval mine** designed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** in collaboration with the **Indian Navy**.
 
• This mine is equipped with advanced technologies to detect and target enemy vessels based on **multiple influence parameters** such as **magnetic, acoustic, pressure, and seismic signatures**.
 
• The successful testing of this mine demonstrates India's progress in developing **self-reliant defence technology** and contributes to the **Make in India initiative**.
 
• The **Multi-Influence Ground Mine** plays a key role in enhancing the **underwater defence capabilities** of the Indian Navy.
 
• Its advanced features provide strategic advantages in **maritime warfare** and bolster India's security in the **Indian Ocean Region**.
 
• The testing conducted in May 2025 validates its **performance, reliability, and operational efficiency** in real-world conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Barak Mine**__

 __
 
• The term "Barak Mine" is not associated with any known underwater naval mine developed by India.
 
• However, the name "Barak" is linked to the **Barak missile system**, a surface-to-air missile jointly developed by India and Israel, which is used for **naval defence**.
 
 
 
• **Sea Dragon**__
 __
 
• "Sea Dragon" is not a recognized underwater naval mine developed by India.
 
• The term could refer to a **maritime exercise or a codename** used for some naval equipment globally but does not pertain to India's defence technology.
 
 
 
• **Varunastra**__
 
 
• **Varunastra** is an advanced **heavyweight torpedo** developed indigenously by the DRDO for the Indian Navy.
 
• It is designed for deployment from **submarines and surface ships** to target enemy vessels.
 
• Unlike mines, torpedoes are actively propelled and guided, making them different from the passive nature of underwater mines.
